title: Fixed-G1 into G2 at 125.7778: measured retention and exact r-1, traps priced by a measured pattern union bound, GT-priced auxiliary work

claims.statement: For the fixed nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 supplied by the challenge and uniform z in the order-r subgroup of GT (identity included), the disclosed classical algorithm returns Q in G2 with the pinned reduced pairing e(P,Q)=z for that exact supplied P with probability at least 0.39, and its complete classical work is at most 2^125.7778 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents at the protected C=20000, summed over all processors with no amortisation. The algorithm solves a = log_g z in GT with g = e(P,Q0) on the twelve-element Frobenius classes, N = (r-1)/12 = 2^251.27 classes, ord_r(p) = 12. One step computes the twelve class keys of the state y: min{keys12(y)} is the sigma-invariant class key used by the distinguished-point predicate and by the table row index, and the index of that minimum is kappa. Then either y is squared with the labels doubled (three of every eight classes) or y is multiplied by the pre-expanded table entry TBL[t][col] = sigma^{-col}(M_t) = g^{u_t p^{-col}} with the first label increased by U[t][col] = u_t p^{-col} mod r (five of every eight), where col equals kappa unless row t occurred among the last D=12 multiply steps of this trail, in which case the column recorded then is reused. r-1 is factored exactly in factor_r.py and the product is re-multiplied and asserted: r-1 = 2^32*3*11*19*10177*125527*859267*906349^2*2508409*2529403*52437899*254760293^2, 255 bits, twelve distinct prime factors, every factor prime by Miller-Rabin over twelve bases; ord_r(p) = 12 is established by p^12 = 1 with p^6 != 1 and p^4 != 1; p^6 mod r = r-1 is checked, h = p^6 is not 1 and h^2 = 1, so the order-2 element exists, equals r-1 and is unique in F_r^*; ord_r(2) has 251 bits, so 2^s != 1 for every s up to the walk length. The guard removes every absorbing all-multiplier cycle of length at most 2D+1 = 25 structurally: in such a cycle any two positions are at cyclic distance at most D, so a row's second visit reuses the first visit's column and each row group contributes #visits*u_t*p^{-k} with 0 < #visits <= 25 < r, never 0 mod r. Longer cycles are priced by a UNION BOUND OVER ROW PATTERNS, not by multiplied independent factors: a return at lag L needs a pattern with at least L/2 repeated rows, of which at most C(L,L/2)*R^{-L/2} of the R^L row words qualify, times the conditional return probability given the pattern, which is measured as theta = 4.246e-06 (aggregate CP-95 upper bound, 0 returns in 706500 pattern occurrences at R=64, pattern lengths 2..6); at R=2^14 and L=26 this gives 10400600*2^-182 per pattern family, 7.315e-54 per step and 2^-50.7 over the whole walk, plus 26/r per step for squaring-containing cycles, whose closure needs 1-2^s != 0 and so at most one exponent per pattern. Retention is MEASURED, not asserted: two trails on the same element with rings drawn from independent walks, at the shipped depth D=12, are retained when the joint state (element, ring tuple) coincides within D steps and stays equal for a further D steps; over R = 64, 256, 1024 the measured rates are 0.1175, 0.4767 and 0.7175 with implied 1/R coefficients 56.5, 134.0 and 289.3, matching the analytic 1-2D^2/R value 0.7188 at R=1024 where that form is testable, and the ledger charges the CP-95 lower bound on 1 - c/R at R = 2^14 with c_hi = 311.99, namely rho = 0.9809578. The class marginal is measured and NOT uniform at fixture scale: chi-square 238889.4 on 526 degrees of freedom, p-value 0, worst cell 6.57 times the mean, 527 of 785 cells visited, with chi-square over df 27.1, 71.8 and 454.7 at S/sqrt(N) 0.71, 1.79 and 7.14; the measured second moment is sum_c p_c^2 = 1/N_eff = 0.004708 against 1/N = 0.001274, so the birthday law priced with N uses the smaller pairwise collision probability and is conservative, and the credit is not taken. Per-step cost in counted instructions: a 21921-instruction multiply step and a 13445-instruction squaring step, made of the dense Fp12 multiply 20000, a 1613-instruction twelve-key selector on every step, a 48-instruction guard on the multiply channel, a 16-instruction column address, a 72-instruction table fetch, a 28-instruction label add, a 72-instruction key mix and the Granger-Scott cyclotomic squaring at its itemised 11632 (24 Fp multiplications plus 122 Fp additions). The squaring share is ONE number, the routing share f = 3/8, used for the step price, for the step budget S and for the success model; S is the least integer with S^2(1-f^2) >= 2*mu*N*ln(1/(1-0.3996095)) at mu = 11/10, giving log2 S = 125.828667; c_raw = 0.937125 and c_stress = 0.965333 with every judgement-bounded fold row repriced at 13/10, giving W_raw = 2^125.734981 and W_stress = 2^125.777765; the claim 125.7778 is the least four-decimal log2 value above log2(W_stress) + 2e-5. Success is Lambda = S^2(1-f^2)/(2*mu*N), 1-exp(-Lambda) = 0.3996095, net of the MEASURED retention 0.9809578 giving 0.3920000 against the 0.39 floor. Records are 112 bytes (48-byte class key plus two full 32-byte exponent limbs) in one shared store; each trail starts from a fresh uniform label pair and ends at its first distinguished point of mean 2^80 steps, the reporting trail is replaced by a fresh one, and no live trail is ever restarted, aborted or re-seeded. The report count is a CAP of ceil(S/2^80) = 62488992187645 records with a stated and charged overflow policy (drop-oldest plus drain, priced at one lookup and one record write per dropped record); peak storage is 6998767244821104 bytes over store, labels, the U labels, the twelve-column advice, guard history, code and scratch. Auxiliary work is charged as GT tower arithmetic rather than scalar instructions: a dense Fp12 multiply is the reference operation, a GT squaring is the counted cyclotomic row 11632 instructions = 0.58160 reference units, and a 381-bit exponentiation is 381 squarings plus at most 191 dense multiplies = 411.59 reference units, charged twice per trail start, giving 2^55.517 for trail starts and 2^40.255 for the shared-store lookup; aux total 2^55.517 is 2^-70.26 of W_stress. A repeated class key solves by trying x = (p^j a2 - a1)/(b1 - p^j b2) for j = 0..11 and VERIFYING each candidate by exponentiation against z, so a wrong shift costs a verification and never a wrong answer; j = 6 is the involution case x = -(a1+a2)/(b1+b2). The shipped evidence is a real-tower toy executing the same guarded step: an exhaustive return census over all 9420 fixture starts at the shipped depth D=12 comparing the FULL joint state (element, ring tuple) for 26 steps, with joint_min_lag null and zero joint returns, while the element ladder of the same run has 12 returns all at lag 15 (the element and joint state differ, which v14 stated wrongly), against the depth-0 control returning at lag 2 with 588 element returns and 24 two-cycles; a 256-start 400-step joint window with 156 repeats, disclosed as cycle-dominated at R=8; a pattern census over every row pattern of length 2..6 at R=8 and R=64 with zero guarded returns in 706500 occurrences at R=64; a measured class-frequency vector with its chi-square, p-value and per-block split; a retention sweep at R = 64, 256 and 1024 at the shipped guard depth; 768/768 element-level equivariance checks with zero splits, 0/384 coalescence splits from independent same-class starts against 349/384 for the control, 256/256 exact inverse pairs with 32/32 label-bit solves verified and 0/32 for the sign-flipped control, 144/144 end-to-end solves across all twelve shifts with exactly one verified candidate each and zero zero-denominators, and 24/24 checks on BLS12-381 itself including a real pairing evaluation of a planted instance. The census at 6400 trials per density recovers 0.7316 at 2^-5 (CP-95 lower 0.722296) and 0.5262 at 2^-7 (CP-95 lower 0.515898) with every collision solved and verified and zero invariant, attribution or zero-denominator failures; those fixture rates are disclosed as fixture-scale because the toy table has 64 rows against production 2^14 and the fixture is cycle-dominated, so they measure the merge-solve-verify mechanism and its density trend rather than a production recovery rate. Success is conditional on three disclosed hypotheses: the class walk behaves as a random map to within the carried 10 per cent inefficiency allowance, the routing fields derived from the class key are pseudorandom, and the algorithm's coins are ideal. No production run, no unconditional success theorem, no novelty claim and no practical break is claimed.
